original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 23 System Reset structure and its reset capability, boot-option, count, limit and timer fields against the approved platform specification without initiating a reset.
original_method: Through protected read-only OS access, collect complete raw Type 23 structures and exit status, bind them to the SUT/SMBIOS/parser identity, decode all applicable fields and compare them to the owner-approved capability matrix while proving no reset or watchdog state changed.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies Type 23 reset/watchdog semantics and expected values; an operator verifies the target and safe read-only window while automation collects and compares metadata only.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 23 handle count and reset-capability state
Expected boot option, reset count/limit, timer interval and timeout values/units
Watchdog and BMC reset-policy relationship where applicable
Supported dmidecode/parser version and unknown/not-provided rules
Protected credential/host verification, redaction and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep the procedure strictly read-only; do not issue reset, reboot, watchdog or power commands
Do not change BIOS/BMC reset policy or counters to match expected data
Do not clear logs before preserving relevant baseline evidence
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete stdout/stderr and exit status; no heading-only grep verdict
Bind output to the exact SUT and distinguish SMBIOS metadata from live watchdog state
Stop on malformed/truncated or unit-ambiguous data and require owner interpretation
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, expected Type 23 matrix and no-reset boundary
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 23` through protected access
Parse every structure and all reset/boot/count/limit/timer fields
Apply only documented units, enum and unknown-value semantics
Optionally correlate approved read-only watchdog/BMC policy evidence without changing it
Report the field comparison and no-reset audit without issuing the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Type 23 capability, timer and watchdog semantics
Resolve unknown, unsupported or absent fields
Confirm any supplemental read-only BMC/watchdog cross-check
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 23 selector matches the source, but the filter hides most capability fields and the sshpass/disabled-host-key wrapper exposes credentials and weakens target binding.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 23`, retaining complete stdout/stderr, exit status, target identity and parser version; do not invoke any reset or watchdog command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 23 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE23 CAPABILITY MATRIX AND NO-RESET READ REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the complete Type 23 structure into capability, boot option, reset count/limit and timer fields, validate their units and sentinel values, and compare against the platform matrix while recording a no-reset/no-policy-change audit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full-field parsing, unit semantics, secure identity-bound access and an explicit separation from reset actuation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A `System Reset` heading neither validates the structure fields nor proves a reset occurred—and this row does not request an actual reset.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Type 23 describes firmware-advertised reset/watchdog characteristics; it does not by itself prove live watchdog functionality or BMC reset behavior.

project_override_considerations: A Project may add a separate live reset/watchdog testcase, but its hazardous stimulus and recovery evidence cannot be merged into this read-only metadata case or inferred from Type 23 values.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, timestamp and approved Type 23 matrix
Complete raw Type 23 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed capabilities, boot option, count/limit and timer values with units/sentinels
Optional read-only watchdog/BMC policy correlation plus no-reset/no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a read-only SMBIOS Type 23 System Reset metadata check. Missing expected capability/timer values are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 23 collection and comparison are deterministic once the platform capability matrix and parser semantics are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct Type 23 read while adding complete reset/watchdog fields, unit semantics, protected access and an explicit prohibition on confusing metadata inspection with reset execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The phrase System Reset can invite an unsafe actuator substitution, but Type 23 is descriptive firmware data. Correctness is established by decoding its full capability and timing record against SPEC while proving the SUT was not reset; an observed reboot would be collateral mutation, not additional coverage.
